description: Fill (or stroke) items with a gradient swatch and place it the way the Gradient tool does: on each object, or with across: true as one gradient spanning all of them (one gradient across several objects). Give an angle, or from and to points to place it exactly like dragging the Gradient tool (for a radial gradient, from is the centre and to a point on its edge). The gradient can be a document swatch or come from a built-in gradient library (Window > Swatch Libraries > Gradients, the gradient presets), which is loaded first

across.description: One gradient spanning the combined bounds of all the targets. Default false (each object gets its own)

angle.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise; 0 runs left to right. Default 0

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

from.description: Start point, artboard points from the top-left

library.description: Built-in library to load the gradient from when the document lacks it, e.g. "Gradients > Water"

stroke.description: Apply to strokes instead of fills. Default false

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_gradient
title: Apply Gradient
